title: OpenAI-compatible provider mode for the local AI inference server
intent: Teach the bot and RAG embedding seams to speak the OpenAI-compatible protocol (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings) alongside the default Ollama protocol, so the operator's existing llama.cpp server (192.168.1.121:8080, Qwen3.5-9B) can power the live AI contour without installing Ollama.

requirements.title: Dual-protocol provider seam
requirements.description: Add CHATTY_BOT_PROVIDER_API and CHATTY_RAG_EMBEDDING_API knobs ('ollama' default, 'openai' opt-in); implement OpenAI-compatible clients behind the existing Protocol seams; keep error kinds and transport injection for tests; cover both modes with pytest.
requirements.source: operator decision 2026-10-16: use the existing OpenAI-compatible inference server; docs/deployment/own-backend.md AI smoke section

constraints: Ollama mode stays the default; no behavior change for existing deployments.
No cloud endpoints; the OpenAI-compatible client only targets the configured local URL.
backend core (app/core, api, services) is not modified beyond wiring that already exists; the seam files own the change.
RAG rows stay honestly UNAVAILABLE while the server has no /v1/embeddings endpoint.
